conditions: Steady inviscid flow of constant positive density along a streamline in uniform gravity; no external mechanical energy addition or loss; h increases upward.

evidence: Along a streamline, steady inviscid Euler flow gives v dv+dp/rho+g dh=0. For constant density and uniform gravity integrate to obtain the three-term conserved quantity. Each term has pressure units.
